chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Forbid your women from breastfeeding (multiple children) on the right and left, for they tend to forget.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on women breastfeeding multiple children or for extended periods according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises against alternating the right and left breasts during nursing, warning that such practice causes women to 'forget' their duties or natural instincts. Shia scholars interpret 'forgetting' (yansayna) as a distraction from maternal responsibilities or a weakening of the bond with the child due to inconsistent nursing patterns. This reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on structured, mindful caregiving within the family unit.
